extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia readers and prospective article creators / editors
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for people who encounter a missing-article notice on Wikipedia and for those who want to create or request a new article (checks, account requirements, alternatives, and troubleshooting).

rubrics_metrics.name: Search for existing or alternative titles
rubrics_metrics.description: Please search for 'Late show' in existing articles to check for alternative titles or spellings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title. This helps determine whether an article already exists under a different title or whether a redirect is appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmed requirement to create pages
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you are not logged in or not autoconfirmed, you cannot create the page directly; consider the alternative workflows (article wizard, request).

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the article wizard or request a new article as alternatives
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you cannot or should not create the live article (due to account status or other reasons), submit a draft through the wizard or ask the community to create it.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check for recently created pages / database delay
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Wait a few minutes or try the purge function to ensure you're seeing the latest database state before creating a new page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title capitalization and redirect suggestion
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before creating a new page, verify capitalization variants and, if an article exists under a different capitalization, add a redirect rather than creating a duplicate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check the deletion log if the page was deleted
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see 'Why was the page I created deleted?'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Review deletion history to understand why an article was removed before attempting to recreate it; follow community guidance to avoid repeated deletions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Look for incoming links to the title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identifying incoming links can show whether the topic is already discussed elsewhere and inform whether to create an article, a redirect, or to expand existing coverage.
